title: Supplement tracker
items: Build your daily stack — name, dose, and when you take each one (morning, pre-workout, evening, anytime).
Tick supplements off as you take them; today's progress and your last 7 days show at a glance.
That completes every sidebar tracker — Workout, Gaming, Meal, Calendar, Goals, and Supplement are all live.

title: Goals
items: Set goals that are measurable (run 100 miles), streak-based (30 days straight), or simple done/not-done.
Add the 'why' behind each goal, an optional deadline with overdue & due-soon flags, and log check-ins that build a history.
Hit a rough week? Pause or adjust a goal instead of giving up. Reaching a target auto-completes it with a little celebration.

title: Smoother & faster
items: Charts now size themselves instantly — no more flicker or repeated console warnings.
Lighter background effects for noticeably smoother scrolling, especially on Brave.

title: Smarter targets, workout guides & more foods
items: Meal: choose a goal — lose, maintain, or gain — and your calorie & protein targets adjust to match.
Workout: every split now has a day-by-day exercise guide with sets, reps, and how to train for strength, size, or tone.
Added a 'Glute & Lower Focus' routine and ~55 more foods to the estimator.

title: Calendar
items: Plan your days with typed, checkable plans — workout, meal, gaming, goal, or other.
Everything you've tracked (workouts, meals, gaming) is overlaid right on the calendar.
Month view with a day panel to add, time, and tick off plans.

title: Update log, favorites & hardened security
items: Added this update log — tap the spark icon by your profile to see what's new.
Meals: save individual items as favorites (not just whole meals) and re-add them in a tap.
Consistent, themed date pickers across every tracker.
Tightened the site's Content-Security-Policy to a strict, nonce-based policy.

title: Meals got a lot smarter
items: Build a meal from multiple items with a built-in calorie & macro estimator.
Daily targets are auto-suggested from your profile and fully editable.
Today's totals and macros update live as you log.

title: Gaming tracker
items: Track multiple games, set daily/weekly goals, and log sessions.
See your win rate trend and matches by game.
Save a tracker.gg link for quick access (auto-sync coming later).

title: Dark mode & a live dashboard
items: New black-and-purple dark theme with a toggle (follows your system by default).
The dashboard now reads your real workout & gaming data.
A tailored weekly summary that reads like someone looked through everything.

title: Account & security
items: Set a unique username and a profile photo.
Two-factor authentication via an authenticator app.
Google & Discord sign-in, plus password reset.
